europe_now.title: French Unrest and Security Response
europe_now.summary: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has ordered localized curfews following widespread riots, looting, and vandalism across the country. President Emmanuel Macron rejected the interior minister's resignation while facing significant political fallout and pressure over the crisis.

sources.headline: French PM orders ‘localized’ curfews in response to looting and unrest
🔴 Live: Macron rejects French interior minister's resignation after weekend of unrest

europe_now.title: Airspace Incident Involving Ukraine and Lithuania
europe_now.summary: Lithuanian authorities reported that a Ukrainian drone which struck a car had entered its airspace coming from Poland. The cross-border incident highlights regional security concerns regarding the ongoing conflict.

sources.headline: Lithuania says Ukrainian drone that struck car entered its airspace from Poland

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: France has experienced severe nationwide protests, riots, and looting that prompted emergency government meetings and cleanup operations. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu responded to the unrest by implementing localized curfews.

sources.headline: Massive clean-up operation sweeps across France after protests

top_stories.title: European Industrial Policy and Automotive Strategy
top_stories.summary: Recent policy developments have focused on a new Franco-German automotive deal aimed at protecting combustion engines. Observers and critics have raised concerns regarding whether the agreement adequately safeguards European employment.

sources.headline: Europe’s new Franco-German auto deal will protect combustion engines, not European jobs
